Action: treat any new SHORT opened while BTC > ema300 and tape >80% long-bias as an urgent exit candidate.

PATTERN 2 — MID-BAND CHOP ENTRIES, BOTH DIRECTIONS (7d, n=126 with meta_rsi, reproduced). LONG: <45 = 15T/7W/-0.36 | 45-55 = 34T/9W/-1.84 (worst) | 55-65 = 24T/11W/-0.54 | 65+ = 14T/7W/+1.10 (only positive). Note: open DOGE #16323 sits at meta_rsi 28.6 (<45 band, 47% WR) — acceptable because it is regime-aligned with a hot 5m trend, but it must prove the bounce fast.
